correctness.rationale: The exact vertex-edge distances were reconstructed from the nested neighborhoods. Any transversal of \(P_r=\{a_r,b_{r+1}\}\) first separates unequal row indices and then unequal column indices. For the lower bound, landmarks on the ordered row-star edges act only as single-position markers or one-threshold markers, so \(k\) effective landmarks create at most \(k+1\) codes and at least \(p-1\) are required. Applying the same bound to prefix and suffix star subfamilies at equality excludes the ineffective endpoints and forces exactly one landmark in every \(P_r\). Independent exhaustive enumeration for \(2\le p\le8\) found no generator of size \(p-2\) and matched the transversal classification exactly.

value.rationale: Half graphs are the canonical twin-free chain graphs. The result determines not only a scalar edge metric dimension but every minimum edge-resolving set and its exact count, exposing a rigid local pair-transversal structure. That is a natural complete classification rather than a routine example computation.
residual_risks: Scope is limited to the standard half graph and does not settle arbitrary chain graphs with twin classes.
